intelligence.essence: Just because you can doesn't mean you should. Smart finds the fastest road; wisdom checks the destination first. That is the whole of it: before you do anything, you stop, you think, and you ask whether it is right — and only then do you move, at full speed.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have the fastest legs in the world. You could run anywhere, right now. But the wise thing is to look where you are running first — because running fast in the wrong direction only gets you lost faster. So you look, you choose the right way, and then you run as fast as you can. That is what being wise means.
